text:
Rae: ran a 10-min guerrilla test on the playground. main friction: users can't tell whether the 'Preview' action applies to the single highlighted function or the whole run. also some confusion around the tiny icon-only toolbar (no labels).
Owen: saw same thing. idea: keep visible verbs short (Run / Preview) and show scope hint inline like 'Run • selection' or a small chevron to switch scope. this keeps compact layout but communicates scope.
Lina: a11y notes: icon-only controls at 16px + no focus ring = bad for keyboard/screenreader users. propose: 1) add aria-labels with explicit scope (e.g., aria-label="Run preview for highlighted function"), 2) bump clickable target to 24px, 3) make focus outline 3:1 contrast and persistent for keyboard users.
Marco: implementation constraint: Monaco iframe hosts the editor toolbar. we'll need a postMessage bridge for keyboard shortcuts and focus moves. prefer short visible label + aria-describedby pointing to hidden tooltip rather than long inline text to preserve layout.
Rae: UX compromise: short visible label + on-hover/focus tooltip that reads: 'Runs the selected function or all functions in this invocation. Shortcut: Shift+Enter.' tooltip should be reachable via aria-describedby.
Owen: small copy change for run history: testers misread 'Ran 3s ago' as a runtime position. recommend 'Completed 3s ago' when state is finished, and 'Running (3s)' while in progress. clear tense helps comprehension.
Lina: status indicators rely on color only. need icon + succinct label 'Success'/'Failed' visible, and aria-live announcement when status changes. also consider adding a non-color affordance like a small shape next to the icon.
Marco: agree on icons; to keep perf intact, lazy-load the svg sprite after N items (say 50). also i'll implement a caching header so sprite doesn't reload often.
Rae: function-def editor microcopy: current placeholder 'args: {}' is misleading. change to 'Example args: {"user_id": 1234}' and add muted helper 'JSON or YAML examples accepted'.
Owen: add inline linting state in the editor: quick green check when schema passes, red underline + tooltip for errors. helps reduce trial-and-error during onboarding.
deploy-bot: Deploy: PR #5623 preview deployed to staging/playground-invoke — tests green.
Lina: a11y follow-up: when tool-calling modal opens, focus must be moved into the modal and trapped. Escape should close it, and focus should return to the originating control on close. I'll add automated checks for this.
Marco: I'll split work into two PRs: PR A = accessibility infra + message bridge; PR B = copy updates, tooltips, placeholder text, and svg lazy-load.
Rae: can someone own final copy? @Owen could you draft the final strings and push to staging by EOD tomorrow? I'll run another quick round of testing.
Owen: yep, will post the JSON changes and aria strings here once pushed.
Lina: i'll run axe + voiceover checks on the preview and report issues.
Marco: tagging eng-runtime in case any runtime APIs need subtle adjustments for preview scope behavior.
Rae: summary: short visible verbs with scope hint, clear finished wording in history, icons + labels for status, focus + aria-live for a11y, placeholder improvements, copy owner @Owen, staging check by @Lina, deploy green. thanks everyone :sparkles:
